newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy April/May LSWR.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy April/May LSWR.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) has issued a tender to buy two 500,000-barrel cargoes of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for delivery in April and May, a company official said on Thursday.
The two cargoes are for delivery to the ports of Ulsan and Pusan during April 21-25 and May 11-15.
The tender closes on March 11 and is valid for one day.

KEPCO last purchased two 500,000-barrel cargoes for delivery March 11-15 and March 27-31 at $1.87 per barrel and $2.23 over Singapore spot quotes respectively on a cost-and-freight basis respectively.
